## Natural history notes

A small crab spider characterized by a flattened body, laterally held legs, and pale yellow, tan, or whitish coloration that helps it blend into flowers, leaves, and stems. In Florida, Misumenops bellulus is found in gardens, fields, forest edges, roadsides, wetlands, and other open or semi-open habitats with flowering plants and low vegetation. It is an ambush predator, waiting motionless on flowers or foliage and seizing visiting flies, bees, moths, and other small insects with its enlarged front legs rather than building a capture web.
